title: Launch readiness: debt & staffing sprintmap
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a lightweight working tracker for the next three sprints that ties roadmap commitments to launch gating criteria, staffing availability, and an explicit technical-debt triage column. The goal is to make the tradeoffs visible each week so PMs/product-ops can signal go/no-go earlier and engineering leaders can prioritize dev/QA time without last-minute surprises.

Quick summary (one line):
Map features -> gating KPIs -> staff slots -> debt risk -> mitigation owner. Weekly cadence sync: Tue 10:30am PT triage.

How to use (working rules):
- Owner of a row = product lead. If unassigned, default is the template owner (Maya Chen) until assigned.
- Each sprint row has a primary KPI, a SLO threshold, and a risk flag (green/amber/red).
- Technical debt entries must include approx dev-hours to resolve (T-shirt sizes allowed).
- Staffing column references named oncall/coverage or a short note (e.g., "QA: 1.5d, Eng: 2 engineers for 1 week").
- Move items across columns as work progresses; keep small notes in the comments cell.

Columns we track (spreadsheet mapping):
- ID (short code)
- Feature / Capability (one-line)
- Release type (beta/internal/GA)
- Sprint window (dates)
- Product owner
- Primary KPI (metric + measurability note)
- KPI threshold for green (numeric or qualitative)
- Observability hooks (dashboard / trace / synthetic test)
- Test coverage status (unit/integration/e2e)
- QA signoff ETA (date or TBD)
body_continued:
- Staffing notes (names / % allocation / blockers)
- Technical debt (short description + severity (low/med/high) + estimated effort)
- Debt mitigation plan (owner, timeframe)
- Phase-gate checklist (preflight items for go decision)
- Escalation owner (who to loop in if metric failing)
- Current risk flag (green/amber/red)

KPI examples (operationalized):
- Latency P95 for inference path: < 450ms is green, 450-700 amber, >700 red. Dashboard: infra/latency/p95-releaseX
- Cost per 1k tokens: target < $0.85 green, $0.85-1.2 amber, >1.2 red. Linked calc: shared-sheets/cost-models
- Error rate (5xx + model-fallbacks): <0.5% green, 0.5-2% amber, >2% red.
- Activation adoption signal: 25% DAU uplift in cohort within 14 days = green.

Phase-gate checklist (stoplight items – minimal for a sprint to be considered on track for rollout):
- Feature completed in feature branch and reviewed (PR merged: yes/no)
- Canary infra config validated and smoke tests pass (yes/no)
- Golden prompt set run: quality regression < defined delta (yes/no)
- Observability hooks deployed: dashboards + alerts configured (yes/no)
- SLOs measured in staging for 48h under target traffic (yes/no)
- Compliance & privacy signoffs (if customer-facing) (yes/no)
body_followup:
Staffing readiness matrix (practical shorthand):
- R: Release lead (1)
- E: Engineering coverage (names, % allocation)
- Q: QA / E2E test coverage owner (name, slots)
- S: Support oncall (rotation id)
- O: Observability / SRE on-call (name)
- Note: If any of R/E/Q missing or under 50% allocation, automatic amber flag until coverage confirmed.

Technical debt triage (lightweight):
- Label debt as: block (prevents feature), high (significant risk), medium, low.
- Estimate backlog hours: S/M/L/XL and a numeric approx where possible.
- If debt is block or high and effort > 2 dev-weeks, escalate to eng leadership and re-evaluate scope.
- Mitigation options: (1) defer scope, (2) dedicate hotfix sprint, (3) scope to MVP + post-launch backlog.

Example rows (seeded):
- ID: LR-101; Feature: streaming tokens partial-response API; Release type: beta; Sprint: 2025-02-17 to 2025-03-02; Owner: Elena Ortiz; KPI: P95 latency < 450ms; Staffing: Eng 2x (40% each), QA 1x (50%); Debt: memory-leak in cache module (med, 3d); Risk: amber; Action: temporary cache TTL + bugfix scheduled in sprint 7.
- ID: LR-102; Feature: per-route cost telemetry; Release type: internal; Sprint: 2025-02-24 to 2025-03-09; Owner: Ravi Patel; KPI: cost attribution accuracy >98%; Staffing: Eng 1x (60%), Analytics 0.5; Debt: tagging gaps on older SDKs (low, 2d); Risk: green; Action: ship with SDK caveat, roll-out to customers with note.

Decision heuristics (how we flip amber->green or fail to GA):
- If KPI is amber due to infra and rollout would expose customers to >1% error rate or >1.5x cost increase, delay GA and run a 1-week mitigation sprint.
- If amber is due to staffing (missing QA or SRE signoff), we have a 3-business-day window to allocate or risk a postpone.
- If amber due to debt classified as block, stop and form a cross-functional patch squad.

Open questions / TODO (notes to self):
- Confirm owner for LR-107 (data privacy review) — pinged Legal (Noah) on 2/16, awaiting reply.
- Align on sliding window for KPI measurement (24h vs 48h) for smaller beta cohorts.
- Add synthetic test definitions into the observability hooks column (work with SRE).

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Tue triage: walk through rows LR-101..LR-110, update risk flags. (Owner: Maya)
- Create dashboard folder and link entries for each KPI (Owner: Noah)
- Put debt items with >1dev-week into dedicated backlog ticket list and label for escalation (Owner: Ravi)

Notes on provenance and context:
- This is a working doc intended to sit alongside the formal launch playbook and the product-ops sprint board. It is intentionally terse — use the linked artifacts for canonical designs, and this sheet for the weekly operational view.
- Keep comments brief. If longer discussion required, move to PRD or Slack thread and add link.

Changelog:
- 2025-02-10: Created (seeded with LR-101/102).
- 2025-02-12: Added phase-gate checklist (Elena).
- 2025-02-18: Updated staffing matrix and added decision heuristics (Maya).

End of doc.
